control400.boundary: 400setback does not earn unconditional X separation of full hand/tool and conservative factory box. It needs an actual curved-body/pose proof; do not promote the earlier optimistic straight-neck reference.600buys whole-box separation.

clearanceDerivation.role: Derived whole-body clearance then rounded600 shift; no iteration of50mm cover or shallow beam passes.

operator.posture: Explicit seated reference: shoulders150each side and75north of body centre; both tools share ONE shoulder height per bolt. All shoulder points remain within R300. Actual knees/torso/head/seat, both hand placement/removal and loaded trial remain physical requirements.

tools.stack: Project M20/30AF reference,25flange+3washer+50native socket+22head-centre reserve =100each side. Native PCD/fastener/gasket/engagement and actual ratchet head must be confirmed; no complete native joint pass.
tools.sampling: Five actual clock samples,720handle angles,17active stroke positions and33shaft positions. Counterhead fixed; no convenient shortening of active return stroke. Sampling is a necessary reference, not continuous contact proof.

supportInterface.movingFrameAndPipeReference: Reprice full4900body/850gross frame and unchanged blocked masses. No previous4700/251.5kg handling result transfers.
supportInterface.hold: Actual separate carrier pedestals, coupled screw supports, guide/stops and lower rails still require full bodies/load paths. No staff-platform or pile load is borrowed. The worker leaves before any pipe motion.

nextWholeAccess.status: One complete-access geometric rewind for root review; no HAD adoption or actual pressure/firstwet/material/site/physical release. Native final torque may reject manual actuation. Actual supports and downstream work position remain finite exits.

platform.material: 316L stainless reference; density/E/170MPa proof stress are explicit calculation hypotheses, not a supplied section/weld/material acceptance
platform.materialSourceBoundary: Supra316L/4404 ASTM A240 sheet/plate table gives170MPa; density8.0 and ambient E200GPa.193GPa is a lower calculation hypothesis. No actual RHS/bar/weld product certificate, corrosion/water exposure or whole assembly is accepted.

pointLoad.boundary: Uniform pressure over the actual200square print, wholly on deck; not an isolated toe on one bar.

steelScreen.boundary: Elastic isolated bars/frame; welded grating load transfer, lateral stability, joints, fatigue, slip, corrosion and real contact remain open.

horizontalControl.role: Authored maintenance disturbance at upper hand datum; not a claimed guard/ladder standard. Independent existing guard is retained.

platform.padBoundary: Four300square pads entirely within well plan with25 reserve. Four actual independently qualified compression/lateral/uplift foundations are required. Freestanding contact is NOT an earned support under the adverse lateral case; no borrowing of P36/P37, waterproof box, piles or unsurveyed bearing.

geometry.boundary: D1800 gives only500 below100deep platform, before pads/actual ground variation. Grade and heave/ventilation reserve must be qualified locally; D1800 is a comparison, not a site promise.

platform.waterBoundary: Open platform is not the court water skin or a retaining wall. Keep separate metal flange/track leak catch and80outlet with visible accessible drainage. No credit for full duty, common receiver backwater or groundwater. No resident or essential service depends on dewatering.

rcComparator.reason: No retained-earth duty is earned600above D1800grade. Heavy suspended RC box fails actual cage; no reason to inherit it as the ordinary staff floor.

access.type: Removable near-vertical service ladder; not ordinary stair
access.sequence: Both complete passive water/weather routes arranged and tested as source requires; all ten well covers captured/removed before ladder installation. Positively secure head/feet and handholds; separately lower restrained tools. Keep ladder/exit clear of operator, pipe and catch. Evacuate before any carrier motion.
access.holds: Exact loaded ladder body/head/heel interface, hand transitions, recovery, temporary roof/head clearance and protected entry still require source solids and forces. The inherited4×180/3×200 stair cannot silently serve this level.

carrierSupport.boundary: Separate retained rail/grid foundations and captured lifting saddles, not the staff platform. Full3kN retained even after drain; includes blocked tube water. Four end-level screw supports/positive mechanical stops and lower running rails require real full bodies, feet, brake/reaction, loaded contact and support ownership before use. No personnel beneath load, no flange carries it.

initialMotion.sequence: Remove/support downstream terminal first, opening east end. Load captured frame supports, separate west gasket10east while still at installed level; stop and positively hold. Lower whole assembly40 on locked/captured supports BEFORE further draw. Prove all initial supports/tolerances, then engage lower rails and draw. Reverse: stop10short, raise40, then close axial10. No sloping cam/free gravity drop.

recommendation: Develop the open independently supported metal staff platform and one rigid draw-out carrier. Reject the RC enclosure preference and inherited standing/reach assumptions. The ordinary manual tool is a necessary finite reference only: native bolt/counterhold and complete support geometry remain genuine internal exits, so release is HOLD.
hold: No new route, platform, ladder, seal, clock, frame or sequence is adopted. Resolve actual matched flange/counterhold and first support bodies before claiming eight-bolt release; real grade/foundation/drainage and physical use remain named site/physical admission boundaries.
